title: Marginal Persistence and Dynamic Copula Dependence in Sovereign Rating Migration Counts: A Discrete Interval-Likelihood MAGMAR Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2604.07567v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper develops an observed-data likelihood for applying moving-aggregate modified autoregressive (MAGMAR) copula time-series models to discrete sovereign rating-migration counts with time-varying exposure. An annual count identifies a probability-integral-transform interval rather than a unique latent point, so the likelihood integrates the latent process over the complete sequence of count intervals. A guided sequential Monte Carlo implementation incorporates the parameter-dependent stationary marginal adjustment of MAGMAR directly inside this integration. In sovereign ratings from Fitch, Moody's, and S\&P over 1963--2025, the migration counts are strongly overdispersed relative to a binomial margin and, under an exposure-conditioned static beta-binomial margin, MAGMAR improves substantially on MAG. The interpretation changes once the marginal mean is allowed to depend on the lagged migration rate: residual serial correla

translated_title: 主权评级迁移计数中的边际持续性与动态Copula相依性：一种离散区间似然MAGMAR分析
translated_abstract: 本文为将移动聚合修正自回归（MAGMAR）copula时间序列模型应用于具有时变敞口的离散主权评级迁移计数，发展了一种观测数据似然方法。由于年度计数对应的是概率积分变换的一个区间而非唯一的潜在点，因此似然函数需将潜在过程在整个计数区间序列上进行积分。一种引导式序贯蒙特卡洛实现方法将MAGMAR中依赖于参数的平稳边际调整直接纳入该积分过程。基于1963年至2025年惠誉、穆迪和标普的主权评级数据，研究发现迁移计数相对于二项边际呈现强烈的超离散性，且在以敞口为条件的静态贝塔-二项边际下，MAGMAR显著优于MAG模型。一旦允许边际均值依赖于滞后迁移率，对结果的解释便会发生改变：残差序列相关（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了针对离散主权评级迁移计数的区间似然MAGMAR copula建模方法，解决了计数区间化带来的似然积分难题，并实证表明该模型在捕捉评级迁移的超离散性、边际持续性与动态相依性方面显著优于传统MAG模型。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a discrete interval-likelihood framework for applying MAGMAR copula time-series models to sovereign rating migration counts, and demonstrates empirically that the model substantially outperforms MAG in capturing overdispersion, marginal persistence, and dynamic dependence in rating migrations.
